instructions.question: Does this comment express warm, supportive sentiment, open hostility toward the institute, government or people, or neither?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default and is broad. Complaints, policy criticism, doubts or questions about figures, error corrections, worry or sadness about cases, ironic jokes, town-ranking banter and tags are neutral unless there is an explicit insult or a direct charge of lying or fraud. Positive needs warmth: thanks, praise, blessings, sincere hope, or caring advice to stay safe.

neutral.what: Questions, requests, policy criticism, scepticism about figures, arithmetic corrections, worry, anecdotes, jokes, laughter, tags, town-league banter.
examples: Sa keq, numri kaq i larte [What a pity, such a high number]
Une e di një procedurë se qysh me pas t’infektun më pakVetem beni teste ma pak edhe ska [I know a way to have fewer infected: just do fewer tests and there are none]
Vitia e lshoj frotin [Vitia dropped off the front]
neutral.cues: a/pse (questions), duhet (should), lshoi bajrakun (dropped the flag), prin (leads), ma gjall (livelier), hahaha, tagged names, numbers
neutral.not_for: Explicit lying accusations or insults (negative); heartfelt thanks or blessings (positive).

positive.what: Thanks, praise, congratulations, sincere prayers, hope about improving numbers, caring calls to protect each other.
examples: Urime të Sheruarve! [Congratulations to the recovered!]

Kujdes vllazni se dona ta mbyllim vetëveten nëse vazhdon kshtu mbane distancën mos dilni pa nevoj [Careful brothers, or we'll lock ourselves in again if this continues, keep distance, don't go out without need]
Rip covid 19. [RIP covid 19.]
positive.cues: urime (congratulations), ju lumt (well done), perhajr (all the best), zoti e sheroft (God heal), dhasht Zoti (God grant), respekt (respect), bravo
positive.not_for: Jokey 'ishalla' or 'ma gjall' cheering of counts, plain notes that cases dropped (neutral).

negative.what: Open hostility: calling officials liars or cheats, scornful virus denial, insults, contempt, partisan corruption jabs.
examples: Rrenaa.mashtrime politike [Lies, political deceptions]
A boni teste pa libreze partie? [Do you test people without a party card?]
Situata nën Kontroll o minister ZEZA [Situation under control, minister — DISASTER]
negative.cues: rrena (lies), mashtrim (deceit), spo ju besoj (I don't believe you), hajna (thieves), budall (fool), turp (shame)
negative.not_for: Doubts, corrections, complaints, worry or ironic jokes without insult (neutral).
